explanation: Pinning base image versions prevents unpredictable upstream breaking changes during CI/CD builds. In addition, using an Alpine-based image reduces attack surface and container size.

patch.replacementCode:
FROM node:20.12.0-alpine3.19
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["npm", "start"]
patch.rationale: Pins Node.js 20 LTS on Alpine Linux, isolates dependencies, and switches to non-privileged 'node' user.

warnings: Verify whether any native addons require libc dependencies before switching from Debian to Alpine.
